ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by query fit. The question is a simple science explanation with an instruction-following constraint ("be concise"). Plover-235B has higher scores on factual knowledge (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.1 vs 54.3) and instruction-following (IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6), so it's better suited to deliver an accurate, appropriately brief answer. The two models' main behavioral difference is tolerance for harm-adjacent content, which is irrelevant to a benign health question—so I defaulted to the stronger general-capability model.
